# goslop text fixture — ValueError:pass after .index() lookup with a default
# None pre-init (niquests kiss_headers header_strip FP)
lang: python
file: utils.py
---
def header_strip(content, elem):
    next_semi_colon_index = None
    try:
        elem_index = content.index(elem)
    except ValueError:
        return content
    elem_end_index = elem_index + len(elem)
    try:
        next_semi_colon_index = elem_end_index + content[elem_end_index:].index(";")
    except ValueError:
        pass
    if next_semi_colon_index is not None:
        return content[:elem_index] + content[next_semi_colon_index + 1 :]
    return content[:elem_index]
